subject: Compare the proportion of variance explained by fixed vs random effects

messages.author: 50b1bca7561c1681
messages.subject: Compare the proportion of variance explained by fixed vs random effects
parts:
Hello,
I use  a NB regression
I19.pred <- inla(n ~ -1 + Intercept +
                     mkl +
                     f(w, model = spde),
                   family = "nbinomial",
                   data = inla.stack.data(All.stacks),
                   control.inla = list(strategy = "laplace"),
                   control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE, config = TRUE),
                   control.predictor = list(link = 1,
                                            A = inla.stack.A(All.stacks)))

where  
spde <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(mesh,
                              prior.range = c(30, 0.05),
                              prior.sigma = c(0.4,  0.05))
and 
    w.index <- inla.spde.make.index(
    name    = 'w',
    n.spde  = spde$n.spde)
 and I would like to compare the proportion of variance explained by fixed (mkl) vs random effect. Any idea?
